# `firearms.model` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The pure part: the stat derivation function and the shared attach function, with no Minecraft imports (docs/spec/operations/testing.md).

### `record Attachment(String id, Slot slot, List<Modifier> modifiers, double zoom)` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Attachment.java`
An attachment item: its id, slot, stat modifiers, and (optic-only) zoom.
- `Attachment SUPPRESSOR` — Suppressor: spread ×0.90, muzzle velocity ×0.97.
- `Attachment COMPENSATOR` — Compensator: recoil ×0.75.
- `Attachment FLASH_HIDER` — Flash hider: spread ×0.95.
- `Attachment RED_DOT` — Red dot: spread-while-aiming ×0.85, zoom none (1.0).
- `Attachment HOLO` — Holo: spread-while-aiming ×0.85, zoom none (1.0).
- `Attachment SCOPE_2X` — 2x scope: spread-while-aiming ×0.75, zoom 2.0.
- `Attachment SCOPE_3X` — 3x scope: spread-while-aiming ×0.65, zoom 3.0.
- `Attachment SCOPE_4X` — 4x scope: spread-while-aiming ×0.55, zoom 4.0.
- `Attachment SCOPE_6X` — 6x scope: spread-while-aiming ×0.45, zoom 6.0.
- `Attachment SCOPE_8X` — 8x scope: spread-while-aiming ×0.35, zoom 8.0.
- `Attachment SCOPE_15X` — 15x scope: spread-while-aiming ×0.25, zoom 15.0.
- `Attachment EXTENDED_MAGAZINE` — Extended magazine: magazine size ×1.5, reload ×1.1.
- `Attachment QUICKDRAW_MAGAZINE` — Quickdraw magazine: reload ×0.8.
- `Attachment EXTENDED_QUICKDRAW_MAGAZINE` — Extended quickdraw magazine: magazine size ×1.3, reload ×0.95.
- `Attachment VERTICAL_GRIP` — Vertical grip: recoil ×0.85.
- `Attachment ANGLED_GRIP` — Angled grip: reload ×0.9.
- `Attachment HALF_GRIP` — Half grip: spread ×0.9.
- `Attachment LIGHT_GRIP` — Light grip: fire rate ×0.95 (faster — fewer ticks between shots).
- `Attachment THUMB_GRIP` — Thumb grip: recoil ×0.9.
- `Attachment TACTICAL_STOCK` — Tactical stock: recoil ×0.85.
- `Attachment CHEEK_PAD` — Cheek pad: spread ×0.9.
- `Attachment BULLET_LOOPS` — Bullet loops: reload ×0.85.
- `List<Attachment> ALL` — All 22 attachments, in the table's own order, muzzle through stock.

### `enum Caliber` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Caliber.java`
The six 1.0 calibres, one per weapon, none repeated (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` WEAPON-DEC-002); the matching set of cartridges is `docs/spec/domains/ammo.md`'s own territory, not this package's.
- `Caliber(String displayId)`
- `String displayId()` — The real-world designation as `docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` and `domains/ammo.md` write it.

### `class Clamp` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Clamp.java`
The out-of-range clamp-and-log path a datapack's own weapon/attachment data can trigger (`docs/spec/contracts/public-surface.md` SURFACE-REQ-002): a derived stat that falls outside its valid range is clamped to the nearest valid value and reported once, rather than crashing the derivation, mirroring create_synthetic_diamonds's WeightedPick.of and create_villager_customers's own SURFACE-REQ-002 precedent.
- `double atLeast(String field, double value, double min, Consumer<String> onClamped)` — Clamps value to at least min, reporting once through onClamped when it does.
- `int atLeast(String field, int value, int min, Consumer<String> onClamped)` — Clamps value to at least min, reporting once through onClamped when it does.

### `enum FireMode` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/FireMode.java`
The three fire modes the 1.0 roster uses (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3, WEAPON-REQ-004).

### `class Loadout` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Loadout.java`
A base weapon plus zero or more present attachments, one per slot (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §2 "Multiplicity").
- `Loadout bare(WeaponBase base)` — A weapon with no attachment present in any slot.
- `Loadout with(Attachment attachment)` — Returns a copy of this loadout with attachment present in its own slot, replacing whatever this loadout already carried there.
- `WeaponBase base()` — This loadout's base weapon.
- `Optional<Attachment> attachment(Slot slot)` — The attachment present in slot, if any.
- `Map<Slot, Attachment> attachments()` — Every present attachment, keyed by slot, in Slot's own fixed order.

### `record Modifier(Stat stat, Op op, double value)` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Modifier.java`
One attachment's effect on one stat: stat op value, folded onto the running total by StatDerivation in fixed slot order (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` WEAPON-REQ-003).
- `Modifier multiply(Stat stat, double factor)` — A multiplicative modifier — every 1.0 attachment modifier is this shape.
- `Modifier add(Stat stat, double amount)` — An additive modifier; no 1.0 attachment uses this, kept for `Op.ADD`'s own order-sensitivity proof.
- `double apply(double runningValue)` — Applies this modifier to a running value: ADD sums, MULTIPLY scales.

### `enum Op` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Op.java`
How a Modifier combines with a stat's running value during derivation.

### `enum Slot` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Slot.java`
The five attachment slots, declared in the fixed application order the stat derivation function folds modifiers in: muzzle, optic, magazine, grip, stock (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` WEAPON-REQ-003).

### `enum Stat` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Stat.java`
Every field of Stats an Modifier may target (`docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §3).

### `class StatDerivation` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/StatDerivation.java`
The pure function deriving a weapon's final stats from its base plus every present attachment (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` WEAPON-REQ-003): folds each present attachment's own modifiers onto the base stats in the fixed slot order Slot declares — muzzle, optic, magazine, grip, stock — for determinism.
- `Stats stats(Loadout loadout, Consumer<String> onClamped)` — Derives loadout's final stats, folding every present attachment's modifiers over the base weapon's own stats in fixed slot order, then clamping the result into range.

### `record Stats(double damage, double muzzleVelocity, double spread, double spreadWhileAiming, int fireRateTicks, FireMode fireMode, int magazineSize, int reloadTicks, double recoilVertical, double recoilHorizontal, int durability, int pellets, double zoom)` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/Stats.java`
A weapon's full stat set, either a base weapon's own numbers (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3) or the result of folding a Loadout's present attachments over them (StatDerivation).

### `record WeaponBase(String id, WeaponClass weaponClass, Caliber caliber, Stats baseStats)` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/WeaponBase.java`
A base weapon: its id, class, calibre and bare Stats, with no attachment folded in yet.
- `WeaponBase M1911` — M1911 — Pistol, `.45 ACP` (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3 roster row 1).
- `WeaponBase MICRO_UZI` — Micro Uzi — SMG, `9mm` (roster row 2).
- `WeaponBase AKM` — AKM — Assault rifle, `7.62mm` (roster row 3).
- `WeaponBase RUGER_MINI_14` — Ruger Mini-14 — DMR, `5.56mm` (roster row 4).
- `WeaponBase AWM` — AWM — Sniper rifle, `.300 Magnum` (roster row 5).
- `WeaponBase WINCHESTER_MODEL_1897` — Winchester Model 1897 — Shotgun, `12 gauge` (roster row 6).

### `enum WeaponClass` — `src/main/java/firearms/model/WeaponClass.java`
The six 1.0 weapon classes, each with a fixed per-class slot set shared by every weapon in that class (`docs/spec/domains/weapon.md` §3, WEAPON-REQ-001).
- `WeaponClass(Slot... slots)`
- `Set<Slot> slots()` — The slots a weapon of this class carries; only these can ever hold an attachment component.
- `boolean hasSlot(Slot slot)` — Whether a weapon of this class has the given slot at all (`docs/spec/domains/attach.md` `ATTACH-FAIL-001`).
